name: vantik-analytics
description: Vantik Analytics — Enterprise Analytics Intelligence Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vantik/design-tokens && npm run build --workspace @vantik/api && npm run build --workspace @vantik/web-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @vantik/api" "npm run dev --workspace @vantik/web-app"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @vantik/api && npm run test --workspace @vantik/web-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vantik/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @vantik/web-app
